description: This file contains utilities for manipulating PyTorch FX graph modules, including swapping modules, optimizing graph structures, and removing extraneous pytree calls during model export and transformation processes.

methods.name: set[torch.fx.Node] _get_getitem_users(node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Identifies nodes that use getitem operation on a given node.

methods.name: None _try_remove_connecting_pytrees(curr_module_node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Attempts to optimize and remove connecting flatten/unflatten pytree calls between modules if conditions are met.

methods.name: None _remove_extraneous_pytrees(gm: torch.fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Removes unnecessary pytree flatten/unflatten calls from the FX graph for optimization.

methods.name: tuple[list[torch.fx.Node],dict[str,torch.fx.Node]] _construct_inputs( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, signature: ModuleCallSignature, node_name_map: dict[str, torch.fx.Node], )
methods.description: Constructs input nodes for a module call based on the signature and existing nodes.

methods.name: torch.fx.Node _insert_call_module( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, args_nodes: list[torch.fx.Node], kwargs_nodes: dict[str, torch.fx.Node], module_to_swap: torch.nn.Module, name: str, )
methods.description: Inserts a call to a module within the FX graph at a specified location.

methods.name: None _deconstruct_outputs( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, signature: ModuleCallSignature, module_node: torch.fx.Node, node_name_map: dict[str, torch.fx.Node], orig_outputs: tuple[torch.fx.Node, ...], )
methods.description: Deconstructs module outputs into tensors using a flatten node and updates the graph accordingly.

methods.name: torch.fx.GraphModule _swap_module_helper( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, modules_to_swap: dict[str, torch.nn.Module], module_call_graph: dict[str, ModuleCallSignature], )
methods.description: Performs the core logic of swapping modules in the FX graph, including fuse, replace, and cleanup steps.

methods.name: None _fix_input_output_signature( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, signature: ModuleCallSignature )
methods.description: Removes pytree processing from the signature and embeds it directly into the FX graph for optimization.

methods.name: torch.fx.GraphModule _swap_modules( ep: ExportedProgram, modules_to_swap: dict[str, torch.nn.Module] )
methods.description: Main entry function to transform an ExportedProgram into an FX graph with specified modules swapped in.
